newsitem.title: USA: Medialink signs pact with ABC Radio.
newsitem.headline: Medialink signs pact with ABC Radio.

text.p: Medialink Worldwide Inc said on Wednesday that it has entered an agreement with Walt Disney Co's ABC Radio to transmit the text advisories of Medialink's radio news releases into more than 1,000 radio newsrooms via the ABC Radio Newswire.
This agreement expands an existing relationship with ABC Radio, under which Medialink audio projects are delivered to newsrooms via ABC satellite facilities, the company said.
Medialink provides video and audio production and satellite distribution services to television and radio stations on behalf of corporations and other organizations.
